title: Bus Service Eligibility by Enrollment Type
content:
Whether a student keeps regular district bus service, or qualifies for the choice program hub shuttle, depends on the enrollment type the student holds under Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions.

| Enrollment type | Eligible for regular district bus service to the campus attended | Qualifies for the choice program hub shuttle |
|---|---|---|
| Attendance Zone Enrollment | yes | no |
| Intra-District Transfer (Space Available) | no | no |
| Intra-District Transfer (Employee Child) | no | no |
| Non-Resident Transfer | no | no |
| Choice Program Enrollment | no | yes |
| Pre-Kindergarten (State-Eligible) | no | no |
| Pre-Kindergarten (Tuition-Based) | no | no |

Read across a row: of the seven types, only Attendance Zone Enrollment keeps regular district bus service, and only Choice Program Enrollment qualifies for the hub shuttle. A student on any of the three transfer types or either Pre-K type has neither.
